# Commit map, 2026-09-24

On 2026-09-24 the history of `main` was rewritten so that every commit names the repository owner as its author
and committer. No file changed: the rewritten `main` has the same final tree (`a09ad6a`) and every commit keeps its
content, message and dates. Hashes quoted before that day, in `docs/LEDGER.md`, `docs/handover.md`,
`docs/agents/reference.md`, the reviews and old commit messages, are the old ones; this table gives each old hash
(first 12 characters) its new one. A short hash from those documents matches the start of an old one here.
